name: AnySave
author: BarKuperman
description:
AnySave lets you open .metro and .json save files even when their required train or map mods are not installed.

- Saves that use unavailable maps will load with only their tracks and routes. Roads, buildings, water, and parks will not be displayed.
- AnySave may add substitute trains when the original train mods are missing. These are not the same trains used in the original save and are not recommended for normal gameplay.
- **AnySave is intended primarily for viewing maps** not playing them.
